fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x19939C0 (size 16, default null handle). bg3.exe+0x198DF20 (ecl::EquipmentVisualsSystem) walks a per-frame map {owner entity -> array of slot bytes}; for every slot it fires a signal with {entity, slot}, creates a fresh event entity and writes the map key (the owner whose equipment visuals were updated) here. Capture: one and the same handle 0x0140000100003931 in all 16 instances.

fields.name: Slot
fields.evidence: Same loop: one byte taken from the slot array of that owner (the system puts 3,4,5,6 = MeleeMainHand..RangedOffHand into such arrays with FUN_1410449e0). Creator default 0x13. ItemSlot is uint8_t. Capture first byte: 0,1,2,3 (the other 7 bytes are garbage).

fields.name: _Pad9
fields.evidence: padding; creator writes one byte only, capture shows garbage

open_questions: Slot is taken as ItemSlot from the values pushed (3..6) and the captured 0..3; the creator default 0x13 (ItemSlot::MainHand) looks like an 'invalid' sentinel - not checked against a reader.
raw_check: 8 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
